name: application-inline-validation-hint
title: Inline Validation Hint
description: Field-level success/error message paired with a border-color change and an icon, meant to appear after a field loses focus — distinct from form-row's static help/error text.
useWhen: Showing live success or error feedback for a single field after the user finishes typing or blurs it.
Confirming a value is valid (e.g. an available username or a valid coupon code) as well as flagging an error.
You want the field border, an icon, and the message to change together as one status, not just static help text.
avoidWhen: The message is static and doesn't change based on user input — use application-form-row's plain help/error text instead.
Validation happens only on submit, not per-field — a single form-level error summary is more appropriate.
The field has no meaningful pass/fail state, only optional guidance — use plain help text instead of a status hint.
responsiveBehavior: The field and hint stack vertically at any width; wire your own container width around the component in a form grid.
accessibility: The input's aria-describedby points at the hint's id so assistive tech announces the message when the field is focused.
Error hints carry role='alert' so screen readers announce them immediately when they appear; success hints do not, since they are not urgent.
Status is communicated with an icon and text together, in addition to color, so it does not rely on color alone.
aria-invalid is set to true only in the error state, reflecting the field's real validity to assistive technology.

variants.title: Message below field
variants.description: Field with a colored border and a below-field message pairing an icon with success or error text.
accessibility: The error message carries role='alert'; the success message does not, since it is not time-sensitive.

variants.title: Message below field (Dark)
variants.description: Below-field validation hint adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Border and message colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Trailing icon in field
variants.description: Field with a trailing status icon inside the input itself, plus a short message below — suited to compact values like codes.
accessibility: The trailing icon is supplementary; the message text and aria-invalid state carry the actual meaning.

variants.title: Trailing icon in field (Dark)
variants.description: Trailing-icon validation hint adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Trailing icon and message contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
